subject: MAP: evaluation milestones & staggered TPM ramp — proposed schedule
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeretail.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evaluation milestones & staggered TPM ramp — proposed schedule

Hi Sara / Tim,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that aligns the evaluation gates, acceptance criteria, and a staggered ramp toward a committed TPM cadence so finance and cloud procurement can forecast spend. Key points:

- Pilot (0–30 days): proof-of-concept with sample traffic, KPI = 95th percentile latency < 450ms and token accuracy checks on 500 eval prompts.
- Ramp phase A (months 1–3): soft commit to 50M TPM/month across dev/staging with preferential pricing at Tier 1.
- Ramp phase B (months 4–6): reach 150M TPM/month, subject to acceptance criteria and a volume discount ladder.
- Final commit (month 7+): 400M TPM monthly commit with deeper discount and reserved capacity.

I've also attached our projection template (acme-usage-projection.csv) so you can plug in expected query patterns. Please review the MAP_Acme_v3.pdf and highlight any adjustments (especially around the acceptance pass/fail criteria or the timing of discounts).

Proposed next steps:
1) You review and mark any objections by Wed 5/6.
2) We'll run a 2-week pilot the week of 5/11 if the MAP is green.
3) If pilot passes, Marcus will follow up with formal pricing and a draft SOW.

Would you be OK with that timeline?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v3.pdf (PDF, 6 pages), acme-usage-projection.csv (CSV, 1 file)
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeretail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation milestones & staggered TPM ramp — proposed schedule

Priya — thanks for the clear plan and attachments. Overall this looks good and aligns with what finance is willing to model, but two questions before we sign off on the MAP:

1) Pricing step-down: can you confirm the exact list price / Tier 1 / Tier 2 token rates? Our CFO needs numbers to compare against our current provider.
2) Failure mode: if the pilot fails acceptance, do we roll back to an on-demand option without penalty, or is there a termination fee tied to reserved capacity?

Also: our 30-day pilot cannot burst beyond 100k TPM sustained during the window due to internal rate limits on the test environment. Please confirm Redwood can support that profile without degrading latency across other tests.

If we can get those two items clarified by EOD Tue (5/5) we can commit to the pilot week of 5/11.

—Sara
Sara Lewis
VP, Head of AI Platforms | Acme Retail
Sara.Lewis@acmeretail.com | +1 212-555-0199
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeretail.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation milestones & staggered TPM ramp — proposed schedule

Sara — quick answers inline: 

(1) Pricing: base list price is $0.0008/token. Proposed MAP tiers (monthly TPM):
- Tier 1 (0–50M TPM): $0.0007/token
- Tier 2 (50–150M TPM): $0.00055/token
- Tier 3 (150–400M TPM): $0.00042/token
We can add a short-term promotional credit for the pilot covering up to $5k of usage if the pilot runs to completion.

(2) Failure mode: pilot only = no penalties. Any reserved capacity or committed discounts are only effective after signatures on the SOW. If you opt for a soft commit (month-to-month ramp) we can structure a 30-day cancellation window from the start of each billing period.

(3) Throughput profile: Redwood runtime can sustain a 100k TPM test burst for the pilot environment. We'll throttle across environments to protect production; latency SLOs will still apply for the pilot traffic. Marcus will coordinate an infra prep call with your infra lead.

I'll draft a short pricing appendix and a pilot terms addendum and share by EOD 5/5.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Tim Chen <tim.chen@acmeretail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeretail.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation milestones & staggered TPM ramp — proposed schedule

Team — small security ask from our side that could affect timing: we need a short document confirming data residency for logs and the ability to rotate keys monthly with our KMS provider. If Redwood can provide a standard annex or a SOC2 control mapping excerpt that states log retention and KMS integration, we can sign the MAP on our side.

Also, will any user data be routed through Redwood's hosted public API during the pilot, or can we run the pilot in a private VPC? The latter would ease our compliance review.

Tim
Tim Chen
CTO | Acme Retail
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeretail.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation milestones & staggered TPM ramp — proposed schedule

Hi all — looping in a couple of clarifications and next steps from Redwood leadership: 

- Security annex: we have a standard compliance pack and a KMS integration note. Priya / Marcus — I attached the SOC2-excerpt and KMS-integration.pdf to the shared Drive link (see related_links). Tim, we can stand up the pilot in a customer-dedicated VPC at no extra charge for the evaluation window. That will satisfy the residency/rotation ask.
- Pricing appendix: Marcus will upload the pricing appendix and SOW draft by EOD 5/5 as noted. Priya — please confirm you will schedule the infra handoff call with Acme for 5/7.
- Acceptance criteria: to reduce back-and-forth, let's add a single pass/fail metric: pilot passes if 95% of eval prompts meet the accuracy threshold and 95th pctl latency < 450ms under the 100k TPM burst profile. If the pilot passes, a 3-month soft-commit will kick in with Tier 1 pricing and an option to accelerate to Tier 2 with a 30-day notice.

If Acme is good with that language, Priya can mark the MAP as approved and we can start the pilot week of 5/11.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
